evidence_paraphrase: The chronology begins with ongoing strategic review and ordinary February 2021 convertible financing. Specific bidder contacts began June 2021, initially around collaboration. Following July product approval, management and advisors explored a confidential sale with several parties. Sanofi private bids in August increased to 9.50 dollars; exclusivity followed August 24 and final negotiation continued in September. The board approved and the parties signed September 7; they publicly announced September 8. Nothing in the complete disclosed deal chronology identifies an executed or publicly definitive company-control agreement at January 1.
